notes: Fast repeated notes now sound: the app lifts a key early so every strike can land, and repeats faster than the piano can manage keep the pulse instead of going silent. New rows on Piano › Playback: Re-strike time (Auto takes the piano's own figure), Dynamic range, Quietest note, and Expression, on by default at Light, which shapes loudness and timing as a pianist would: melody above accompaniment, phrases that swell and settle, downbeats that lean, chords that roll. Dynamics are heard with Full power off on Sound and touch; the page says so. Now playing shows the small album art beside the title.
